item.title: Show HN: Greenlight – Preflight Scanner for App Store and Google Play
item.summary: We built Greenlight because App Store rejections suck. It scans your source, manifests, and IPA/APK/AAB files for Apple and Google Play policy violations. It runs locally with no account or uploads: brew install revylai/tap/greenlight && greenlight preflight .
